EXP-06: frozen clean evaluation

Held-out clean test. All model weights, thresholds and temperatures are frozen. Negative findings remain valid results. Three seeds are not three independent datasets.

8,613 offers from 6,356 applications. Primary contrast: raw T11 minus T00 NLL. Negative favours T11.

Intervals resample whole applications and are descriptive, conditional on the fitted predictors. Reliability panels use top-label confidence. Temperature scaling cannot repair class recall at the fixed decision threshold. GBDT seed duplicates are disclosed in the summary.
